source_document.title: NR Radio Resource Control (RRC) Protocol Specification

intra_nr_handover.description: Intra-NR handover is performed via RRCReconfiguration message with reconfigurationWithSync IE
trigger_conditions: Measurement event A3 (Neighbour becomes offset better than SpCell)
Measurement event A5 (SpCell becomes worse than threshold1 AND neighbour becomes better than threshold2)
Measurement event A4 (Neighbour becomes better than threshold)
procedure_steps: 1. Network sends RRCReconfiguration with reconfigurationWithSync in spCellConfig
2. UE starts timer T304 with configured value
3. UE synchronizes to DL of target SpCell
4. UE acquires MIB of target SpCell
5. UE applies new configuration including new C-RNTI (newUE-Identity)
6. UE initiates Random Access procedure to target cell
7. Upon successful RA completion, UE stops T304 and sends RRCReconfigurationComplete
8. UE releases dedicated preambles if configured

on_t304_expiry: Store handover failure information in VarRLF-Report
on_inability_to_comply: Continue using configuration prior to RRCReconfiguration
Initiate RRC connection re-establishment if AS security activated

handover_success_rate.description: Ratio of successful handovers to total handover attempts

handover_interruption_time.description: Time from last successful data on source to first successful data on target

rsrp_dbm.description: Reference Signal Received Power at handover execution

late_handover.description: HO triggered too late, UE experiences RLF before or during HO
recommended_actions: Deploy new site or adjust antenna tilt

early_handover.description: HO triggered too early, target cell not optimal
indicators: Low RSRP on target at HO completion

ping_pong_handover.description: Repeated HO between two cells in short time
indicators: Multiple HO attempts between same cell pair within seconds
root_causes: Similar signal strength from two cells
Coverage gap between source and target

inter_rat_handover.section_reference: 5.4 Inter-RAT mobility, 5.4.2 Handover to NR, 5.4.3 Mobility from NR
inter_rat_handover.description: Handover between NR and other RATs (E-UTRA/LTE, UTRA-FDD)

trigger_conditions: Source RAT (E-UTRA) measurement report indicating NR target is suitable
procedure_steps: 1. Source RAT sends HO command with embedded NR RRCReconfiguration
2. UE processes RRCReconfiguration from other RAT
3. UE applies NR configuration and initiates RA to NR target
4. On failure, UE performs actions defined in source RAT specifications
1. Network sends MobilityFromNRCommand with target RAT info
2. UE stores handover failure info if available
3. UE releases NR radio resources
4. UE applies target RAT configuration
5. On success, UE notifies NR RRC layer
6. On failure, UE initiates NR RRC re-establishment

actions: Store handover failure info in VarRLF-Report
If re-establishment fails, go to RRC_IDLE

inter_rat_ho_success_rate.description: Successful inter-RAT HO / Total inter-RAT HO attempts

inter_rat_ho_latency_ms.description: Time from MobilityFromNRCommand to successful target RAT connection

conditional_handover_cho.description: Network pre-configures UE with candidate target cells; UE autonomously executes HO when conditions are met

types.CPAC: Conditional PSCell Addition/Change with SCG configuration

trigger_conditions.evaluation: Entry conditions must be fulfilled during timeToTrigger for applicable cell

procedure_steps: 1. Network sends ConditionalReconfiguration in RRCReconfiguration with candidate configurations
2. UE stores configurations in VarConditionalReconfig
3. UE evaluates conditions for each candidate (5.3.5.13.4)
4. When condition fulfilled, UE selects triggered cell
5. UE applies stored condRRCReconfig and executes HO (5.3.5.13.5)
6. UE sends RRCReconfigurationComplete with selectedCondRRCReconfig

key_parameters.condExecutionCond: List of measIds for condition evaluation
key_parameters.condRRCReconfig: Stored RRCReconfiguration to apply when triggered

failure_handling.inability_to_comply: Continue using prior configuration; report via SCG failure info or re-establishment
failure_handling.t304_expiry_during_cho: Revert to source config; store HO failure in VarRLF-Report with choCellId

benefits: Reduced HO interruption time (UE can prepare multiple targets)
Improved reliability in challenging RF conditions
Reduced signaling latency (no real-time HO command needed)

indicators: Normal HO still occurring despite CHO config
root_causes: Condition thresholds not matching RF conditions

T304.description: Handover execution timer - started when reconfigurationWithSync applied
T304.start_condition: When UE applies reconfigurationWithSync for MCG or non-deactivated SCG
T304.stop_condition: Successful Random Access completion to target cell OR successful LTM cell switch

expiry_action.mcg: Revert to source config; store HO failure info; initiate re-establishment
expiry_action.scg: Report SCG reconfiguration failure via SCGFailureInformation

too_short_t304.root_cause: T304 value insufficient for RA procedure completion
too_short_t304.action: Increase T304 value or optimize RACH parameters

too_long_t304.symptom: Extended service interruption on HO failure
too_long_t304.action: Reduce T304 to minimize recovery time

T310.configuration: Via rlf-TimersAndConstants in SpCellConfig or SIB1 (ue-TimersAndConstants)
T310.start_condition: N310 consecutive out-of-sync indications from physical layer
T310.stop_condition: N311 consecutive in-sync indications OR HO completion
T310.expiry_action: Declare Radio Link Failure; initiate RRC re-establishment

T311.start_condition: RRC re-establishment initiated after RLF or HO failure
T311.expiry_action: Go to RRC_IDLE; inform upper layers of RRC connection failure

event_A3.description: Neighbour becomes offset better than SpCell

formula.entering_condition: Mn + Ofn + Ocn - Hys > Mp + Ofp + Ocp + Off
formula.leaving_condition: Mn + Ofn + Ocn + Hys < Mp + Ofp + Ocp + Off

parameters.Ofn: Measurement object specific offset of neighbour (offsetMO)
parameters.Ofp: Measurement object specific offset of SpCell

event_A3.usage: Primary event for intra-frequency and inter-frequency handover

a3_offset.increase: Delays HO trigger, reduces ping-pong, but risks late HO
a3_offset.decrease: Earlier HO trigger, but risks ping-pong

time_to_trigger.increase: More filtering, stable decisions, but slower response
time_to_trigger.decrease: Faster HO decisions, but more sensitive to transients

event_A5.description: SpCell becomes worse than threshold1 AND neighbour becomes better than threshold2
event_A5.usage: Inter-frequency/inter-RAT handover when coverage-based trigger needed

a5_threshold1.lower_value: Earlier trigger when serving cell degrades
a5_threshold1.higher_value: Later trigger, more tolerance for serving cell variation

a5_threshold2.higher_value: Only trigger when strong neighbour available

VarRLF_Report.description: UE variable storing RLF and HO failure information

key_fields.failedPCellId: Identity of cell where failure occurred (global cell ID, tracking area, PCI, frequency)
key_fields.measResultLastServCell: Measurements of failed cell including RSRP, RSRQ, cell-level and beam-level results
key_fields.measResultNeighCells: Measurements of neighbour cells at time of failure
key_fields.timeConnFailure: Time from most recent successful HO or re-establishment to connection failure
key_fields.rlf-Cause: Cause of RLF (t310-Expiry, randomAccessProblem, rlc-MaxNumRetx, beamFailureRecoveryFailure, etc.)
key_fields.reconnectCellId: Cell where UE reconnected after failure
key_fields.choCellId: For CHO failure - target CHO cell identity
key_fields.previousPCellId: Cell before failure (for HO failure - this is source cell)
key_fields.locationInfo: Location information if available (GPS, Bluetooth, WLAN, sensors)

VarRLF_Report.retention: UE may discard after 48 hours from failure detection
rca_usage: Correlate failedPCellId with cell configuration issues
Use timeConnFailure to identify patterns (too-early, too-late HO)
Compare previousPCellId to failedPCellId for HO problem identification

VarSuccessHO_Report.description: UE variable storing successful handover information for MRO

key_fields.thresholdPercentageT304: T304 consumption percentage at HO completion

rca_usage: Identify cells with high T304 consumption (potential HO delay issues)
Correlate with VarRLF-Report for complete HO analysis

symptoms: User complaints of call drops during mobility
diagnostic_steps: 2. Identify failedPCellId patterns (specific cells with high failure)
3. Analyze rlf-Cause distribution (RACH failure vs coverage)
4. Check measResultLastServCell for RSRP/RSRQ at failure
5. Compare T304 values with actual HO duration needs
1. Analyze HO statistics for cell pairs with high bidirectional HO
3. Review A3/A5 parameters for involved cells
4. Compare RSRP levels between involved cells

indicators: HO triggered on small signal variations

symptoms: HO failure after short time on target
Low RSRP on target at HO trigger
diagnostic_steps: 1. Check VarRLF-Report for failedPCellId = target, previousPCellId = source
2. Analyze timeConnFailure (very short = too early HO)
3. Compare source vs target RSRP at HO decision

symptoms: Long T310 running before HO trigger
Very low RSRP at HO trigger
diagnostic_steps: 1. Check VarRLF-Report for RLF without HO attempt
2. Analyze T310 vs HO trigger timing

a3_offset.recommendation: Start with 3dB, adjust based on ping-pong vs late-HO balance

hysteresis.recommendation: Use 1-2dB for stable environments, lower for high mobility

time_to_trigger.recommendation: ms160-ms320 for macro, ms40-ms80 for small cells

t304.recommendation: ms100-ms200 for normal conditions, ms500+ for challenging RF

filter_coefficient.lower_value: Less smoothing, faster response to changes
